big: Nifty Midcap 100 is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Midcap 100 track?
The Nifty Midcap 100 Index is designed to capture the movement of the midcap segment of the market. It holds 100 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
